# ui::TextLayoutRun

Header: `winui/render/TextLayout.hpp`.

One run of same-formatted text in a [TextLayout](text-layout.md) paragraph, with the formatting of any enclosing spans already folded in.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::TextLayoutRun bold{"Important: ", ui::TextStyle{.weight = ui::FontWeight::Bold}};
ui::TextLayoutRun link{"read more", {}, ui::Color::from_argb(0xFF0066CC), 0}; // tag 0
ui::TextLayoutParagraph paragraph{{bold, link}};
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `std::string` |  | UTF-8 text of the run; a `\n` inside it is a hard line break. |
| `style` | `TextStyle` |  | Font, size, weight, italic, decorations and character spacing. Its alignment and wrapping are ignored (the layout's options decide those). |
| `color` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | Unset draws in the layout's default foreground. |
| `tag` | `std::optional<std::size_t>` |  | The caller's own id for the run, carried to hit testing (tag_at()), such as a hyperlink index; unset (the default) is none. |
